answer: Compare with the naive design that gives one vote per address. Here: stake the juror, record the verdict, expire every attestation after 4 epochs, slash any juror that diverges from the quorum median by two bands. Then price it. A whisper campaign needs fresh work every epoch, a bridge of unrelated signers, and a cipher of receipts that survives replay, so 1,000 identities cost 1,000 stakes plus 4,000 renewals a month, more than the work being faked.
